shots.prompt: Nile tilapia (ปลานิล): deep laterally compressed oval body, grey-blue to olive back fading to silvery white belly, 8 to 9 faint dark vertical bars, long spiny dorsal fin, dorsal and tail fins with a reddish-pink tint and dark spots on the tail, medium size.
Silver barb (ปลาตะเพียนขาว): tall deep-bodied fish with large shiny silver scales, slightly golden sheen, small head, forked tail, orange-red tinted pelvic and anal fins, bright reflective body.

Climbing perch (ปลาหมอ): small sturdy fish, dark olive-green to greenish brown body, rough spiny gill cover with a dark spot behind it, spiny dorsal fin running most of the back, rounded tail, slightly lighter yellowish belly.

Snakeskin gourami (ปลาสลิด): flat oval olive-brown body with a dark horizontal zigzag stripe along the side and fine oblique silvery lines, long thread-like pelvic fins trailing below, long anal fin, small upturned mouth.

Walking catfish (ปลาดุก): long scaleless eel-like body, dark brown-grey back with lighter mottled belly, flat broad head, four pairs of long whiskers (barbels) around the mouth, very long dorsal and anal fins, rounded tail, smooth glossy skin.

Striped snakehead (ปลาช่อน): long cylindrical body, snake-like flat head with large mouth, dark olive-brown back with dark blotches and chevron pattern, cream-white belly, long dorsal and anal fins, rounded tail, powerful predator look.

Golden silver barb, golden color variant (ปลาตะเพียนทอง): tall deep body covered with large shining gold scales, bright orange-red fins, forked tail with orange edges, warm metallic glow, very pretty and lucky looking.

Striped catfish / iridescent shark (ปลาสวาย): large torpedo-shaped body, smooth scaleless skin, dark grey-blue back with metallic sheen, a faint dark stripe along the side, silvery white belly, small adipose fin, deeply forked tail, short whiskers.

Clown featherback (ปลากราย): flat knife-shaped silver body with a humped back, very long rippling anal fin along the bottom joining the tail, a row of 5 to 8 large round black spots ringed with white along the lower rear side, small head.

Chao Phraya giant catfish (ปลาเทพา): very large heavy shark-like catfish, smooth grey-blue skin, pale belly, high pointed dorsal fin with a long filament tip, deeply forked tail with long filament lobes, two short whiskers, powerful and majestic.

Seven-striped barb / Julien's golden carp (ปลายี่สก): large elongated golden-yellow body with 7 bold dark brown horizontal stripes along the sides, red-orange fins, forked tail, handsome and rare looking.
Siamese giant carp (ปลากระโห้): huge carp with an enormous head and large upturned mouth, very large silvery scales with dark edges, slightly reddish fins, deep heavy body, ancient giant river fish.

Mekong giant catfish (ปลาบึก), LEGENDARY: gigantic scaleless catfish, smooth grey-silver skin with a soft blue sheen, pale belly, broad blunt head with tiny eyes set low, almost no whiskers, high dorsal fin, forked tail, faint golden magical glow around the edges, majestic legendary creature.

Golden arowana dragon fish (ปลามังกรทอง), LEGENDARY: long elegant body covered with huge shining golden scales that glow, upturned mouth with two short chin barbels, long dorsal and anal fins near the tail, large fan tail, warm golden magical aura and sparkles along the outline.

Moonlight koi carp (ปลาคาร์ปจันทรา), LEGENDARY fantasy: graceful koi with pearl-white scales that softly glow like moonlight, a few vivid red-orange patches on the back and head, long flowing translucent fins and tail like silk, faint pale-blue magical glow along the outline, dreamy and beautiful.
